dim.description: the dimension to do the operation over

out.description: the result tuple of two output tensors (values, indices)
constraints: must be a tuple with two Tensors if provided
out is optional, and if provided, must be a tuple with two Tensors

output.description: a namedtuple `(values, indices)` where `values` is the cumulative minimum of elements of input in the dimension dim. And `indices` is the index location of each maximum value found in the dimension dim.
